title: DIGISNAKE-DT
author: Robbie
description: DIGISNAKE for the Digitakt mk1: a Cartesian step sequencer after MDD Snake (and Make Noise's Rene). Eight steps in a 4 x 2 grid that matches knobs A-H, walked by a path in one of seven shapes, forwards, backwards, ping-pong or at random. Per track, audio (the sample's pitch) and MIDI: NOTES, GATES and VELOCITY pages and a PATH page (ON, SHAPE, DIR, LEN, DIV 1/8 .. 1X and 2X (the track at twice its speed, in per-track SCALE mode), SCALE, RANGE, SHIFT). Press TRIG on the TRIG page to open it; LEFT/RIGHT change page, hold TRIG + YES randomises a page, FUNC + YES all of them, TRIG + REC / STOP copy and paste, TRIG + PLAY clears, TRIG + FUNC + REC prints the snake into the track's trigs, notes and velocities. Not saved with the project yet: print to keep. For OS 1.53 and 1.54; needs core 3.0 and seq-events.
